item.title: 600 trucks a day - a convoy headed to Hamas
item.description: Those 600 trucks of aid that enter the Gaza Strip each day should go to the Druze, not to Hamas. Opinion.

item.title: The creators of "Naza" should have spoken to me
item.description: The film's creators did not have to work very hard to discover the real truth, but the results show that they did not even try - or, even worse, that they deliberately misrepresented it. Opinion.

item.description: Foreign Minister Gideon Sa’ar meets Moroccan counterpart and the two agree to upgrade Israel-Morocco ties, expand flights and appoint ambassadors by the end of 2026.

item.title: Poll: Netanyahu’s bloc takes lead
item.description: Likud loses another seat, falling to 18, while Gadi Eisenkot’s Yashar remains in first place. Netanyahu’s coalition bloc rises to 54 seats, overtaking the Eisenkot bloc.

item.description: NY Times deletes line questioning Israeli victimhood on Oct. 7

item.title: State Department confirms: Abbas denied a visa ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: The State Department confirmed on Wednesday night that it has refused to issue entry visas to Palestinian Authority (PA) chairman Mahmoud Abbas and members of his delegation ahead of next week’s United Nations General Assembly in New York.

item.title: Report: US again denies Abbas a visa ahead of UN General Assembly
item.description: Report: US again denies Abbas a visa ahead of UN General Assembly

item.title: Report: Saudi Arabia strikes bridge in Yemen’s southwestern Taiz province
item.description:
The Houthi-affiliated Al-Masirah channel reported that Saudi Arabia carried out two airstrikes targeting the Al-Barah Bridge in the Makbanah area of Taiz province in southwestern Yemen.
According to the report, this is the second time in two days that the bridge has been targeted.

item.title: Trump: Iran ‘very much’ wants a deal
item.description: President Trump says Iran “very much" wants a deal as he signals the war may be nearing its end and confirms direct contact with Tehran.

item.title: Reports in Lebanon of strikes at several locations in southern part of the country
item.description: Lebanese media reported overnight that strikes were carried out in the villages of Al-Qantara, Al-Nabatieh Al-Fawqa, and Al-Mansouri, as well as in the Wadi Al-Saluki area in southern Lebanon.

item.title: US senators demand Trump release classified Saudi nuclear deal documents
item.description: Bipartisan US senators urge the Trump administration to release classified details of proposed Saudi nuclear deal, including two “side letters."

item.title: The longest and shortest words in the Torah
item.description: We ask Hashem for the blessing of being able to be clever, so that we can use our wisdom to cope well in this world.

item.title: Cyber Directorate warns: Phishing messages impersonating Booking
item.description:
The National Cyber Directorate is warning about phishing messages containing a link to a website impersonating Booking and asking users to confirm a hotel reservation.
The Directorate recommends not clicking the link and instead checking the reservation directly through the official website or app.

item.title: Unusual incident in Kafr Qasim: Stolen IDF LAW missile fired at residential complex
item.description: A LAW missile stolen from the IDF fired at a residential complex in Kafr Qasim. No injuries reported. Police launch a manhunt for suspects.

item.title: Milan Chabad rabbi attacked at bus stop, 3 suspects arrested
item.description: Chabad emissary Rabbi Tzemach Mizrahi assaulted near a Milan bus stop by three men who stole his hat and kicked him. Italian police arrest all three suspects.

item.title: Kansas man arrested for threatening to murder Ben Shapiro on Yom Kippur
item.description: A Kansas man was arrested after allegedly making multiple antisemitic death threats against Jewish right-wing podcaster Ben Shapiro, including an ominous countdown to Yom Kippur.

item.title: Watch: The images the US tried to hide? Damage from Iranian strikes
item.description: Images provided to CBS by US military personnel reveal damage caused to military bases and American property at several sites across the Middle East by Iranian strikes.

item.title: Amit Segal: Saudis ‘don’t pray to Mecca, they pray to Jerusalem’
item.description: Amit Segal highlights the irony of Saudi Arabia reportedly seeking Israeli intelligence against the Houthis after years of publicly criticizing Israel.

item.title: Netanyahu unveils bills targeting those who ‘slander’ IDF soldiers
item.description: Netanyahu announces bills to revoke citizenship from those who slander IDF soldiers and increase potential defamation damages twentyfold following NAZA controversy.

item.title: IDF eliminates three Hamas, Islamic Jihad terrorists planning attacks
item.description: IDF says three terrorists were involved in planting explosives, planning shooting attacks and launching rockets at Israel; strikes carried out to remove immediate threats.

item.title: Hanan Ben Ari surprised by song’s success: “It’s totally crazy, God is a genius"
item.description: Hanan Ben Ari released a live version of “Hashivenu" from his “Hindikim" performance and shared his excitement over the song’s journey: “I discover again and again how little I understand."

item.title: Hezbollah's strategic tunnel system under Ali al-Taher Ridge revealed
item.description: IDF releases new footage from Hezbollah tunnels in the Ali Taher Ridge, where troops uncovered and destroyed strategic terrorist infrastructure.
